description: Rules for the AI RMF question banks (TODO step 4). The banks hold every possible question: one bank of area questions (per mapping row, data/ai/mapping.json) and one of foundation questions (per foundation subcategory, mapping_rules.json foundation). Every question carries who it applies to (roles) and, where needed, producer flags, so build_ai_questions.py picks a client's questions by filtering on the intake answers alone. prepare_ai_bank.py batch gives these definitions to the generator and evaluator; record_ai_bank.py questions checks against them. Model: AI_RMF_Mapping_Sheet_Design.md.

roles.none: An organisation that says it uses no AI. Only questions about AI policy and finding AI that is used without approval (shadow AI) apply.
roles.consumer: An organisation that uses AI built by others (a vendor model, an API, AI inside products) in its processes or products.
roles.producer: An organisation that builds or tunes its own model, from scratch or on an existing model, for itself or to give to others.

roles_note: A question lists the roles it is asked of. A client that is both producer and consumer gets every question tagged consumer or producer. A question tagged consumer and producer is shown as 'both'. Clients unsure whether they use AI are asked as consumers and as orgs with no AI (scope_rules.json client_roles).

area_roles.description: Roles an area question may carry: those of the area's applies_to, plus none for the areas every client gets even with no AI in use (scope_rules.json ai_area_rules.always).

producer_flags.built_on_existing_model: The producer's model is built on an existing model (trained or tuned from a base model). Questions about choosing, checking and monitoring the base model carry this flag.
producer_flags.given_to_others: The producer gives the model to others (clients, partners, an API, devices, open weights). Questions about releasing a model, telling recipients its limits and withdrawing a release carry this flag.

impacts.access: Permissions and credentials used or abused.
impacts.process: A business process or decision goes wrong.
impacts.assets: Model, code or infrastructure stolen, damaged or taken down.
impacts.people: Harm to individuals from what the AI says or decides.

area_question_rule: Each mapping row is asked by exactly one question per role it can carry (one question may carry several roles and cover several rows of the same subcategory).
